It wasn't abandoned, they just moved the download to their own server.

From their blog post:

Some of you might remember that in November 2013, we abandoned SourceForge (SF) as the primary download site for the GIMP installers for Windows platforms and moved the files to our own download server, download.gimp.org

It (SourceForge) also wasn’t a good tool anymore.

  • Tons of advertising, including those “download here” ads that look like actual download buttons, which you would expect on torrent sites but not a “legitimate” site like SourceForge,

  • Forcing more page loads to show you more ads. You know how it brought you to a new page and made you wait 5 seconds to download? They could’ve done that transparently from the download link on the main page. Other big sites have no problem distributing load to mirrors, they don’t need an intermediate page.
